title: Magnetic Drive Pump

introduction.definition: A magnetic drive pump is a sealless centrifugal pump: torque passes from an outer magnet ring on the motor shaft through a stationary containment shell to an inner magnet ring on the impeller shaft. Because no shaft passes through the pressure boundary, there is no seal to leak.
key_points: Zero-emission design: containment shell is the pressure boundary
Product-lubricated sleeve bearings (often SiC) — must not run dry
Metallic shells create eddy-current losses; non-metallic shells avoid them

classification.configuration: Overhung, end suction, sealless magnetic drive, frame-mounted
classification.api_610_type: OH-type sealless; API 685 covers sealless centrifugal pumps

introduction.summary: A centrifugal pump without a dynamic shaft seal. The motor turns an outer ring of permanent magnets; their field passes through a thin, stationary containment shell and drags an inner magnet ring that is fixed to the impeller. The pumped liquid is fully enclosed by the casing and shell, and it also lubricates the internal sleeve bearings — so the pump suits toxic, flammable or costly liquids where leakage is unacceptable.

steps.text: The motor turns the outer magnet ring.
Magnetic field passes through the containment shell and drives the inner magnet ring synchronously.
The inner magnet turns the impeller, which pumps the liquid as a normal centrifugal pump.
Product-lubricated bearings on a stationary shaft support the inner rotor; a small internal flow cools them.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: As end suction centrifugal pumps; slightly lower efficiency with metallic containment shells.

components.key_components: Magnetic coupling, inner and outer magnets, containment shell

parts.name: Volute Casing
parts.function: Collects flow leaving the impeller and converts velocity into pressure in a spiral passage of increasing area, then discharges through a diffuser nozzle.
parts.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, carbon steel, stainless steel (CF8M), duplex.

parts.name: Closed Impeller
parts.function: Adds energy to the liquid; blades between hub and shrouds accelerate the liquid outward.
parts.material: Cast iron, bronze, stainless steel (CF8M, CA6NM), duplex.

parts.name: Rear Casing (Casing Cover)
parts.function: Closes the back of the casing and forms the seal chamber.

parts.name: Containment Shell
parts.function: Pressure-retaining barrier between the pumped liquid and the atmosphere; the magnetic field passes through it.
parts.material: Hastelloy C, titanium or stainless (metallic, with eddy-current heating) or PEEK/ceramic/composite (non-metallic, no eddy losses).

parts.name: Stationary Shaft
parts.function: Fixed journal on which the impeller/inner magnet assembly rotates.
parts.material: Silicon carbide, alumina or hard-coated alloy.

parts.name: Product-Lubricated SiC Sleeve Bearings
parts.function: Radial (and with thrust faces, axial) support of the rotating inner assembly, lubricated by the pumped liquid.

parts.name: Inner Magnet Carrier
parts.function: Driven half of the magnetic coupling; turns the impeller.
parts.material: NdFeB/SmCo magnets, stainless or ETFE/PFA encapsulation.

parts.name: Outer Magnet Ring & Drive Shaft
parts.function: Driving half of the magnetic coupling, mounted on the motor-driven shaft.

parts.name: Bearing Bracket (Drive End)
parts.function: Supports the drive shaft bearings and encloses the outer magnet ring.

parts.name: Drive Shaft Bearings
parts.function: Carries radial load near the impeller end.

parts.name: Flexible Coupling
parts.function: Transmits torque between motor and pump while accommodating small misalignment and allowing separation for maintenance.
parts.material: Steel or cast iron hubs; elastomer or stainless-steel disc elements.

parts.name: Coupling Guard
parts.material: Steel, aluminium or non-sparking brass for hazardous areas.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Frame & End Shields
parts.function: Encloses the stator and supports the bearings; feet or flange mount the motor to the baseplate or pump.
parts.material: Cast iron or aluminium frame; steel fasteners.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Stator
parts.material: Silicon electrical steel, copper magnet wire, Class F/H insulation (typical).

parts.name: Electric Motor – Rotor & Shaft
parts.function: Converts the rotating field into shaft torque (squirrel-cage induction rotor).
parts.material: Electrical steel, die-cast aluminium or copper.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Bearings (DE & NDE)
parts.function: Support the motor rotor at drive and non-drive ends.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Cooling Fan
parts.function: Draws cooling air over the finned frame.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Fan Cover
parts.function: Guards the fan and directs air along the fins.

parts.name: Baseplate
parts.function: Provides a rigid common mounting for pump and driver, maintains alignment and transfers loads to the foundation.
parts.material: Carbon steel, painted; stainless steel for hygienic or corrosive areas.

alignment: Shaft alignment as for coupled pumps.
piping: Support suction and discharge piping independently so nozzle loads stay within the manufacturer's (or API 610/HI 9.6.2) allowable values.
Provide a straight run of at least 5 pipe diameters ahead of the suction nozzle (ANSI/HI 9.6.6 guidance — verify) and use an eccentric reducer with the flat side up.
commissioning: Never run dry — use power or temperature monitoring.

overhaul.task: Inspect sleeve bearings and thrust washers.

lubrication: Product-lubricated internal bearings; drive bearings grease/oil.

script.narration: This module introduces the Magnetic Drive Pump.
A magnetic drive pump is a sealless centrifugal pump: torque passes from an outer magnet ring on the motor shaft through a stationary containment shell to an inner magnet ring on the impeller shaft.
Because no shaft passes through the pressure boundary, there is no seal to leak.
Typical applications include toxic, hazardous and expensive chemicals; acids and alkalis; refrigerants and heat-transfer fluids; pharmaceutical and fine chemical transfer.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Volute Casing, Closed Impeller, Rear Casing (Casing Cover).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.

video_tutorials.title: Magnetic Drive Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Magnetic Drive Pump.
Monitor motor power (dry-run/decoupling detection).
Check containment shell temperature.
Inspect sleeve bearings and thrust washers.
Watch for dry running bearing failure: noise, loss of flow. Common cause: empty suction tank, closed valve.
Watch for magnet decoupling: motor runs but no flow. Common cause: overload, viscous start, solids.
Watch for shell overheating: high shell temperature. Common cause: low flow with metallic shell.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.

questions.question: What forms the pressure boundary instead of a mechanical seal?
questions.explanation: It separates the liquid from the outer magnets.

questions.question: Why must a mag-drive pump not run dry?
options: Internal sleeve bearings are lubricated by the pumped liquid

questions.question: Eddy-current losses occur in…
